subject: general
question: How many non-major (minor) ports are there in India as on 31st October 2022?
solution: The correct answer is __**200.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • India has **13 major ports** and **more than 200 notified minor and intermediate ports.** • **Minor ports **are managed by the **state governmen**t whereas Major ports are managed by the central government. • Minor ports Handle **coastal and fishing trade.**
